race.description: Racing At The Rock NYD Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: HOTSPUR REALE (3) was reported to have not handled a wet track at Sale last start, and he slides down in class for this peak run third up from a spell. The winkers are on, and he can take this out. RATTLE'N'ROLL (1) beat a similar field to this fresh up here 4 weeks ago and will only have to handle an extra 2kg to win again. ADIEU GRASSE (2) hung out around the final turn at Kilmore last start and just battled home into sixth as the favourite nearly 3 weeks ago. He is well worth another chance, so follow your money. MARLION'S DREAM (10) is a durable veteran resuming from a spell, and he normally comes to hand quickly. He is reunited with Damian Lane, who has won twice when aboard him, and the pair merits healthy respect. Check the market moves. EETEEDEE (13) has been improving with racing, and with the right run, she can take this out.
